system:
You repair one knowledge atom that auditors sent back. Use only the supplied evidence sentences; add no background knowledge.

Rules for the repaired atoms:
- One independently assessable claim per atom, written as one sentence that is understood without the source.
- If the atom joined several claims, split it into separate atoms (at most 3), most important first.
- Every atom must be fully stated in the evidence sentences it cites. Remove anything the evidence does not state. Keep quantifiers, negation, hedges, and formulas (LaTeX in $...$).
- Remove procedural or evaluative add-ons and stacked conditions; keep a condition only if the claim is false without it.
- Drop attributions such as "the authors state" when the claim itself is general.
- Use the S label that fits: S1 what it is / S2 how it works / S3 where it ends.
- If no valid atom can be written from this evidence, return an empty list and explain in note.

Output ONLY one JSON object:
{"atoms": [{"statement": "...", "scope": "S1|S2|S3", "evidence_ids": ["..."]}], "note": ""}
user:
CONCEPT: antigen loss

ATOM CART-C05-S1-03 (S1): Antigen loss is identified as one of the major modes of tumour escape from CAR-T cell therapy, alongside immune dysfunction, exhaustion and microenvironment-mediated upregulation of antiapoptotic pathways.

EVIDENCE:
[CART-p0023-s12] To date, antigen loss, immune dysfunction, exhaustion and (microenvironment-mediated) upregulation of antiapoptotic pathways have been identified as major modes of tumour escape from CAR-T cell therapy.

AUDITOR FINDINGS:
- SINGLE_CLAIM: revise — Classifies antigen loss and several independently assessable alternative mechanisms as major escape modes. / Lists four distinct modes of tumour escape from CAR-T therapy that can be assessed independently.
- L1_ONLY: hold — Remove the list of alternative mechanisms; identifying antigen loss as a major escape mode is sufficient.
raw: {"atoms": [{"statement": "Antigen loss has been identified as a major mode of tumour escape from CAR-T cell therapy.", "scope": "S1", "evidence_ids": ["CART-p0023-s12"]}], "note": "Removed the list of other escape modes (immune dysfunction, exhaustion, microenvironment-mediated upregulation of antiapoptotic pathways) so the atom makes one claim about antigen loss."}
